name: dsh-plugins-workspace
description: Public home of Chris Johnson's DeepSeek Harness plugins. Every package under packages/ is an independently installable DSH bundle: read its README, run 'node scripts/verify.mjs' to check the contract, 'node --test' to run the suites.

scripts.check: node scripts/verify.mjs && node scripts/check-plugin-hooks.mjs && node --test packages/*/test/*.test.mjs
